TigerHire — UI resolution · every seat

UI resolution · v5 · every login, every tab, full depth

Five logins. One thread of truth.

Same product, same data — five different front doors. To test that it holds together, follow one thread through every seat: Rahul S. interviewed on Thursday and Ishita hasn't filed the scorecard. The recruiter sees a follow-up. Ishita sees her overdue task. The Head of Talent sees the job stuck at HM feedback. The agency sees their other submissions moving. And Rahul sees "decision pending — with the hiring team." One fact, five renderings. That's the depth test. In v5 every number is a door: funnel stages open their stage lists, every candidate name opens the full profile, and Application Review keeps a quick-reference panel at the bottom so you never lose your place in the queue.

Log in as…

Seats are hats, not headcount. In a one-person HR company the same login wears Recruiter + Head of Talent (the CEO or Director) — the rail simply shows the union (Jobs · Candidates · Portfolio · Governance · Analytics · Hiring Setup), and approvals still leave a named trail: you approved your own rubric, on a date, at a version. Nothing about the structure assumes team size.

One route tree, not three: today recruit/*, company/* and agency/* are parallel page trees maintained separately. In this resolution they collapse into the surfaces above and role decides what each seat sees, not which URLs exist. Candidate portal, public pages and platform admin unchanged.

Build order

Each phase ships alone behind the existing plan-document flag. Old routes redirect — no bookmark dies.

Phase 1

Jobs + Job Dashboard

The spine: Jobs list home, one Job Dashboard replaces the 8 tabs, guided Job Setup sequence.

Phase 2

Application Review

The queue. Reject requires a reason → fairness report + Talent Pool.

Phase 3

Seats

Role-scoped views for HM and agency on the same surfaces; candidate status page.

Phase 4

Candidates + Hiring Setup

Grouped candidates, Talent Pool, org libraries (shared rubrics — the big unlock).

All names fictional; numbers mirror real shapes (380-CV batches, WhatsApp screening, approved rubrics). The one thread — Rahul's overdue scorecard — appears in every seat so you can verify the same fact renders correctly five ways. Nothing ships until this page is approved; the branch claude/ui-v2-jobs-spine is cut and waiting.
